meta.endpoint_A_rate_semantics: pair-weighted eligibility rate on the sealed held-out grid; NOT an operational firing probability
meta.endpoint_B: conditional post-fire controller result — steps 5-7, NOT produced here
meta.conditional_reporting_rule: post-fire results are conditional on a self-selected eligible subset; in STRESS only a minority of sealed pairs reach the controller at all. Arm-vs-arm comparison WITHIN eligible pairs is fair because eligibility is arm-blind; generalising the eligible subset to all conditions is not

version_record.gap: every no-fire was labelled a system-level mission failure or nonattempt, without checking what the attacker actually did

version_record.change: no-fire default label is NO_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT + FIRE_GUARD_COVERAGE_FAILURE; mission outcome split three ways; endpoints A/B/C separated; main effects (OFAT) and interactions (CROSSED) reported apart

no_fire_labels.not_automatic: NO_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT does NOT by itself imply MISSION_FAILURE
